data.what_we_want_to_learn:
From March 22 through the end of April, The Governance Lab is asking YOU to share your views on -- and hear what others have to say about -- the biggest challenges in education in 2021. 

This is the first in a series of online engagements, focusing on the problems of and solutions to the challenges in our education system.
data.share_your_opinions: Because we care about diversity, we also ask you to answer a one-minute optional survey about you.
data.how_to_participate:
1. Click the group below that describes you best.
  2. In response to the question: "Which do you feel is a greater opportunity and need when it comes to the schools in your community? Schools should..."You will be presented with two answer choices.
  3. Tell us which one you think is more important!

NOTE: This project is focused on the US education system. Please only answer if you fall into one of the below three groups who has experienced the US education system.
data.aoi_instructions: Answer as many (or as few) times as you like…or type in your own response! The more you tell us, the better we can all understand the challenges in education today.

data.what_we_want_to_learn_nj: Participate from April 7 - April 30. The New Jersey Department of Education, in partnership with the Governance Lab, wants your input to inform how we move forward together.
data.what_we_want_to_learn_nj_es: Del 5 de abril al 30 de abril, The Governance Lab junto con el Departamento de Educación del Estado de Nueva Jersey, le pide que comparta sus puntos de vista y escuche lo que otros tienen que decir sobre los mayores desafíos en el ámbito educativo en el 2021. Esta es una oportunidad específica para Nueva Jersey en una serie de compromisos en línea a nivel nacional, que se enfocan en los problemas y las soluciones a los desafíos en nuestro sistema educativo.

data.nj_intro: 2020 has been one of the most challenging years for our students, educators, and families. As we move into the next school year, the NJ Department of Education wants to know what you think about the road forward for New Jersey schools. Answer as many (or as few) times as you like…or type in your own response!
data.nj_intro_es: El 2020 ha sido uno de los años más desafiantes para nuestros estudiantes, profesores y familias. Acercándonos al inicio del próximo curso escolar, el Departamento de Educación de NJ quiere saber qué piensa usted sobre cómo orientar el futuro de las escuelas de Nueva Jersey. Responda tantas veces como desee ... o escriba su propia respuesta para que otros puedan votar por ella.
data.intro: 2020 was one of the most challenging years for American students, educators, and families. As we move into the next school year, state and federal government officials have an opportunity to rebuild our education system. Your voice matters so let them know what change you want to see in the future. Answer as many (or as few) times as you like…or type in your own response!
